findings: Original failures coincide with native dxcompiler.dll access violations, not merely an unverified low-memory message.
The supplied adapter-unavailable screenshot corresponds to requestAdapter returning null before UE startup; the browser-internal reason is not proven.
System stability is a priority hypothesis because of the WHEA processor event and separate compiler exceptions.
Affinity also changes scheduling and concurrency. The limited A/B/A observations cannot distinguish hardware instability from a compiler concurrency defect.
No minidump or DXC stack was available in the two archived WER report directories; compiler-internal crash functions were not resolved.
The existing 720p headless pass does not establish stability for the user's high-resolution headful launch.
